doc.title: Ada Rovatti interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 13, 2022

title: Morning email and album prep after Germany
summary: She answers email and sends charts after recording the basic track of her new album in Germany.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Well unfortunately it’s answering email. That’s the first thing you do in the morning, just — I just got back from Germany where I recorded the basic track of my new album and I had to add strings, percussion and soloists so this morning was the time to send some of the charts and update of what’s going to happen. So that’s the first thing — I mean of course in the morning when I get up I put some music on, that always helps, a way to kind of start in a good mood the day, but then there is the kind of haunting task of answering email and business that is not — I mean it helps to kind of moving forward but is not as technical as practicing. I haven’t touched my horn yet, but I will.
